\texttt{SCI-MAP-OD-001}\\\textbf{DECIDED} &
Relative support is an operational policy, with no exposure, precision,
significance, response, completeness, or physical-optimality meaning. &
Preserve the exact population, order statistic, thresholds, and policy identity.\\
\addlinespace[0.35em]
\texttt{SCI-MAP-OD-002}\\\textbf{DECIDED} &
Independent experimentation is unrestricted; official identity and claims
follow mathematical equivalence or versioned change control with appropriate
evidence. &
No permission process for research and no retroactive relabeling.\\
\addlinespace[0.35em]
\texttt{SCI-MAP-OD-003}\\\textbf{DECIDED} &
Every valid map discloses its known MAP-local realized operator.  Upstream-
conditioned and whole-chain responses remain separately typed and honest. &
Unsupported response-dependent claims remain unavailable; later estimates are
new versioned products bound to the original.\\
\addlinespace[0.35em]
\texttt{SCI-MAP-OD-004}\\\textbf{DECIDED} &
Report actual covariance information, domain, assumptions, omissions,
limitations, and lineage; a complete covariance object is not mandatory. &
Unknown is never zero or independence; later estimates have new identity.\\
\addlinespace[0.35em]
\texttt{SCI-MAP-OD-005}\\\textbf{DECIDED} &
A complete logical observation bundle precedes coaddition; physical
persistence follows the effective plan. &
In-memory and persisted/coadd-only routes use identical admission, arithmetic,
identity, and provenance; required publication still completes or fails.\\
\addlinespace[0.35em]
\texttt{SCI-MAP-OD-006}\\\textbf{DECIDED} &
Pointing and OOF may reuse the exact ordinary MAP operator with conforming
inputs. &
Mode WCS/frame, model/fitting, interpretation, outputs, defaults, profiles,
and qualification remain with their owners.\\
\addlinespace[0.35em]
\texttt{SCI-MAP-OD-007}\\\textbf{DECIDED} &
\texttt{coverage\_cut} is finite and nonnegative: zero gives no relative cut;
\((0,1]\) is ordinary; \(>1\) requires an explicit expert request; bad or
missing values fail before support construction or mutation. &
Retain requested, effective, observation-resolved, applied, and realized states/values;
no universal default.\\
\addlinespace[0.35em]
\texttt{SCI-MAP-OD-008}\\\textbf{DECIDED} &
The one-hot lower-inclusive, upper-exclusive containing-pixel family remains
the only ordinary projection. &
Boundary loss contributes nowhere; fractional projection remains deferred.\\
\addlinespace[0.35em]
\texttt{SCI-MAP-OD-009}\\\textbf{DECIDED} &
A canonical target grid may be requested before construction; compatible maps
use exact centered-integer embedding. &
A later crop is a new row-selected product; fractional resampling,
reprojection, and mosaicking remain outside this contract.\\
\addlinespace[0.35em]
